evidence.support_text: In a Freund's complete adjuvant test (FCAT), a cumulative 15 mg of 10% benzyl acetate in FCA was injected intradermally during induction; challenge with 10% benzyl acetate in ethanol. There was no sensitization reaction in any of the guinea pigs.
